🇷🇺  In Russia, isolated cases of the Chinese metapneumovirus are recorded. 

It is transmitted by sneezing, the symptoms of metapneumovirus are the same as with ARVI, runny nose, fever, sore throat and sometimes an upset stomach. 

There is no special treatment, only symptomatic. https://t.co/XMQAUk1bX6

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text: But you should see a doctor immediately if you suspect infection. The peculiarity of the virus is to cause bronchitis, pneumonia, bacterial complications - otitis, sinusitis.

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text:
The virus is dangerous for children under 3 years old, elderly people over 60 years old and patients with chronic diseases. 

A much greater threat is the current rise in the incidence of the California virus, known as swine flu.

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text: It is this virus that should be given special attention. It is insidious with its complications. One of the most dangerous is the syndrome of segmental lung damage. Moreover, pulmonary heart failure can increase dynamically, within a few hours.

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text: With a favorable outcome, you can recover in 2-3 days, which distinguishes the disease from pneumonia.  But with the hypertoxic form, pulmonary edema is possible, usually ending in hemorrhagic pneumonia.

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text: With the development of a severe form of flu, the body temperature rises to 40-40.5 °C. Vomiting, headache, and nosebleeds may occur.

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text: An infectious disease specialist from the Russian Ministry of Health and a representative of the S. P. Botkin Clinical Infectious Diseases Hospital in St. Petersburg talks about this and warns about it.
